led_messages.label: Starting up
led_messages.description: DreamPi is starting and does not answer calls yet.

led_messages.label: Ready for calls, DCNow!
led_messages.description: DreamPi is waiting for the Dreamcast to dial and DCNow! is the selected network.

led_messages.label: Ready for calls, DCNET
led_messages.description: DreamPi is waiting for the Dreamcast to dial and DCNET is the selected network.

led_messages.label: DreamPi not running
led_messages.description: DreamPi has stopped or crashed.

led_messages.label: State unknown
led_messages.description: The add-on cannot tell what DreamPi is doing: its state file is missing or out of date, for example just after DreamPi restarted or while the add-on is not loaded in it. Best used as a last resort (a dim colour, say).

led_messages.label: In a call, DCNow!
led_messages.description: A call is connected through DCNow!.

led_messages.label: In a call, DCNET
led_messages.description: A call is connected through DCNET.

led_messages.label: In a call, Netlink or other
led_messages.description: A call that is neither DCNow! nor DCNET (Netlink, XBAND and so on).

led_messages.label: DCNow! selected
led_messages.description: DCNow! is the selected network.

led_messages.label: DCNET selected
led_messages.description: DCNET is the selected network.

led_messages.label: No IP address yet
led_messages.description: The cable or Wi-Fi is connected, but the Pi has no address from the router yet (DHCP pending).

led_messages.label: No network
led_messages.description: The Pi has no route to the router: a cable is unplugged or Wi-Fi is not connected.

led_messages.label: No internet
led_messages.description: The Pi reaches the router, but not the internet.

led_messages.label: Internet OK
led_messages.description: The Pi can reach the internet.

led_messages.label: DNS failing
led_messages.description: The internet answers, but name lookups (DNS) fail.

led_messages.label: Ethernet connected
led_messages.description: A network cable is connected.

led_messages.label: Wi-Fi connected
led_messages.description: The Pi is connected to a Wi-Fi network.

led_messages.label: Weak Wi-Fi signal
led_messages.description: The Wi-Fi signal is weak (-75 dBm or less).

led_messages.label: Slow connection
led_messages.description: High latency or packet loss to the internet (an average of 200 ms or more, or 10 % of the packets lost). Measured with ping every 30 seconds.

led_messages.label: Modem plugged in
led_messages.description: The modem's USB serial port is there.

led_messages.label: Modem missing
led_messages.description: The modem is unplugged or its USB serial port is gone.

led_messages.label: Under-voltage
led_messages.description: The Pi is getting too little power right now.

led_messages.label: Throttled
led_messages.description: The Pi is slowing itself down right now (power or heat).

led_messages.label: Over 80 °C
led_messages.description: The Pi is 80 °C or hotter.

led_messages.label: 70 °C or warmer
led_messages.description: The Pi is 70 °C or warmer (also true above 80 °C).
